name: BdSLW60-SI
description: Signer-independent benchmark for word-level Bangla Sign Language recognition (BdSLW60): 60 signs, 18 signers, ~9,307 clips, evaluated under a fixed signer-disjoint split. Data are 27-keypoint MediaPipe pose sequences (NOT raw video). Exposes the ~22.46 pp identity-shortcut gap between random-split and signer-independent evaluation. NOTE: pose arrays derived from BdSLW401 are gated by CC BY-NC-ND (see license); this record ships the pipeline + splits + hashes, with arrays released pending author permission.

distribution.name: signer_independent.json
distribution.description: Canonical signer-disjoint split: train {1,4,5,6,8,9,11,12} / val {15} / test {2,13}; pretrain pool {3,7,10,14,16,17,18}.

recordSet.name: clips
recordSet.description: One record per clip: pose sequence, class label, signer id, split.
